title: Dan and the Paper Cut
recap: Dan got a paper cut at Daria's house.

slides.text: On Friday, Dan and his mom went on a walk.
They walked all the way to Daria’s house.
When Dan was folding his paper airplane, he got a papercut that started to bleed.
Dan felt scared when he saw the blood so he took a deep breath to feel calm.
Dan asked Daria’s dad for a bandage.
He put the bandage on Dan’s finger so he could keep making paper airplanes.
